core_obligations: Recall the characterization of projectivity as quasi-projectivity together with properness, which is what allows the two descent statements to be combined (proof lines 2900-2902).
Apply the descent of quasi-projectivity and the descent of properness along the same field extension (proof lines 2903-2905).
Conclude projectivity of X over k from the characterization (proof lines 2900-2902).
difficulty_reason: If X_K is projective over K for some field extension K/k, the lemma concludes that X is projective over k (statement lines 2892-2897). The proof puts the definition to work: a scheme over k is projective exactly when it is quasi-projective and proper, so the conclusion follows from the two descent statements for quasi-projectivity and for properness already proved in the same chapter (proof lines 2899-2905). The claim is H2: the content is the decomposition of projectivity into the two properties whose descent has been established, which is a genuine (if short) reduction rather than a bare citation.
